# Ghar: a private, self-hosted web app for one household

> Ghar is a private, self-hosted web app for one family or household: a shared timeline of moments
> with photos and videos, shared lists of songs, movies and places, and notes, flowers, coupons and
> joke traffic tickets sent to each other. You run it yourself with Docker, people join by
> invitation only, and it is open source under the MIT licence. "Ghar" is the Hindi and Urdu word
> for home.

This file summarises the open-source project for tools that read repositories. A running Ghar
install is private and is not meant to be crawled or indexed.

Facts that seldom change:

- One household per install. No sign-up, no hosted version, not multi-tenant.
- Three mini apps: Our History (timeline, gallery, calendar), Our Corner (shared lists) and Our
  Mailbox (notes, flowers, coupons, citations). A citation is a joke traffic ticket.
- Runs as one app container plus PostgreSQL 17 and a small Valkey cache. Images for amd64 and arm64
  are published at `ghcr.io/things-varun-codes/ghar`.
- Photos and videos stay on the owner's disk by default, or in any S3-compatible bucket. They are
  private, behind signed links that expire within two hours.
- Notes, flowers, coupons and citations are visible only to the sender and recipients, not to admins.
  Nothing is end-to-end encrypted, and there is no two-factor sign-in.
- It is not a photo backup tool, a chore or shopping-list app, or a shared appointments calendar.
- Built with Laravel 13, Inertia 3, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4 and PostgreSQL 17.
- First public release: 1.0.0, on 13 November 2026. One maintainer, in spare time.

- [DEPLOY](https://github.com/Things-Varun-Codes/ghar/blob/main/DEPLOY.md): self-hosting, HTTPS, mail, media storage, upgrades, backups, monitoring, every environment variable.
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/Things-Varun-Codes/ghar/blob/main/SECURITY.md): what Ghar protects against, what it does not, and how to report a vulnerability.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Things-Varun-Codes/ghar/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): the current version and what changed in each release.
